column1: # Candidate GIRO stations for the validation bundles, tab-separated:
# The first six are the stations the app queries live (confirmed answering
# on 2026-07-28). The rest are DIDBase stations with long archives, chosen
# to spread latitude and longitude: mid-latitude both hemispheres, the
# auroral edge, and the equatorial anomaly. A station that answers nothing
# for a month is an ordinary outcome — coverage in 2015 or 2019 is not
# coverage in 2025 — and the readers tolerate absence. Codes and positions
# are from the GIRO station directory; a wrong entry costs one empty
